## 1.12.0-tairiku.2 (2026-10-12)

### X

* Fix **Hide Find more** to also filter `tweetdetail` recommendation entries under posts (もっと見つける).
* Retain the existing Search recommendations filter and **Hide Who to follow**.
* Support X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01. Device UI verification is still pending.
